result.title: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First
result.summary: We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). They have held #1 on L1 since 2026-10-27, albeit a short loss on 2026-11-07. All 235 problems have a site-verified correct kernel; on the 209 public-board problems they are 4.40x faster than the benchmark's reference baseline. The search starts from zero: agents get each problem's PyTorch definition but no reference kernels or official scores. A per-problem archive outside the model holds every correct kernel and its lineage. An LLM controller reads it, picks a parent or a new design, and gives each parallel child agent one direction. Checks outside the model decide correctness. At equal wall time, it beat a coded UCB style tree on 35 of 38 problems by making 2.4x as many correct attempts. Over a thousand agents ran at once, and one warm restart fix raised their evaluation rate 3.6x. We find that the rate of reliable measurements, not the number of agents, limits how far such a search scales. Our code and kernels are available on URL.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CompoundingKernel，一个从零开始通过搜索自动编写 GPU kernel 的自改进 agent 系统：模型外部的按问题存档保存所有正确 kernel 及其谱系，LLM 控制器读取存档后选择父代或新设计，外部检查负责正确性判定，并分析可靠测量速率对搜索扩展的限制。
AI.relevance_reason: 「模型外存档 + LLM 控制器选择父代/新方向 + 外部验证门控」的结构，可能为 LVR 中候选推理轨迹的保留筛选、贡献分配与停止/验证机制提供方法线索，但其任务为 kernel 优化，迁移可行性需核查。
